## Critical Path Analysis

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│             CRITICAL PATH & BLOCKING DEPENDENCIES                 │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

BLOCKING SEQUENCE:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1️⃣  v1.0: Foundation & Agents (35–40 issues)
    └─ BLOCKS: All downstream features depending on agent framework
    └─ CANNOT SKIP: Multi-provider agents are foundational

2️⃣  v1.1: File Organization (20–25 issues)
    └─ DEPENDS ON: v1.0 completion
    └─ BLOCKS: v1.2 documentation consolidation
    └─ REASON: Structure must align before consolidating docs

3️⃣  v1.2: Documentation Governance (20–25 issues)
    └─ DEPENDS ON: v1.1 file org complete
    └─ CAN OVERLAP: v1.3 release hardening (different focus)
    └─ REASON: Must know where files are before consolidating

4️⃣  v1.3: Release Safety (15–20 issues) [PARALLEL TRACK]
    └─ DEPENDS ON: v1.0 agents ready (need to release)
    └─ CAN START: During v1.2 (different workstream)
    └─ ENABLES: Safe deployments in future releases

5️⃣  v1.4: Testing Coverage (15–20 issues) [PARALLEL TRACK]
    └─ DEPENDS ON: v1.0 agents (what to test)
    └─ CAN START: During v1.3 (test framework independent)
    └─ VALIDATES: Agent quality and framework stability

6️⃣  v1.5: Advanced Features & Plugins (20–25 issues)
    └─ DEPENDS ON: v1.0 foundation only
    └─ INDEPENDENT: Can run parallel with v1.1–v1.4
    └─ REASON: Plugins build on agent framework, not infra


PARALLELIZATION OPPORTUNITIES:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

✓ v1.1 + v1.3 can overlap (file org ≠ release hardening)
✓ v1.3 + v1.4 can overlap (release ≠ testing coverage)
✓ v1.4 + v1.2 can overlap (testing ≠ doc consolidation)
✓ v1.5 can run fully parallel after v1.0

✗ v1.1 must complete before v1.2 starts
✗ v1.0 must complete before v1.1, v1.3, v1.4 start
```
